fixed.review_text:
The code has two security vulnerabilities.

**1. preview-origin.ts:37 — CWE-346 (Origin Validation Error) / fail-open postMessage source check**
```
    if (peerWindow && event.source !== peerWindow) return false;
```
The `contentWindow` check runs only when `peerWindow` is truthy. If it is null or undefined, any sender whose `event.origin` equals `expectedOrigin` is accepted. Because that origin is the admin page’s own origin, other same-origin frames or popups can spoof preview messages. The check should fail closed when the peer window is missing.

**2. preview-origin.ts:35 — CWE-346 (Origin Validation Error) / opaque origin accepted**
```
    if (!expectedOrigin) return false;
```
Only an empty origin is rejected. `getPreviewOrigin` (line 18) returns `window.location.origin`, which is the string `"null"` for opaque origins (`file://`, sandboxed iframes). That value is truthy, so `"null" === "null"` passes the check on line 36 and also becomes the `postMessage` target on line 52. Opaque origins must be rejected explicitly.

vuln.review_text:
The code has four security vulnerabilities.

1. **File:** preview-origin.ts, **line 45**, **class:** CWE-346 (origin validation error / optional `postMessage` source check). The `contentWindow` binding is skipped whenever `peerWindow` is missing, so any window on the expected origin is trusted. Relative preview URLs resolve to the admin origin, which makes that check the only thing separating the iframe from other same-origin frames, popups, or XSS.
```
if (peerWindow && event.source !== peerWindow) return false;
```

2. **File:** preview-origin.ts, **line 22**, **class:** CWE-346 (opaque `"null"` origin accepted). `data:`, `about:`, `javascript:`, and similar URLs yield the origin string `"null"`. That value is truthy, so line 43 does not reject it, and line 44 then matches every sandboxed or opaque-origin frame, not just the preview iframe.
```
return new URL(url, baseOrigin || undefined).origin;
```

3. **File:** preview-origin.ts, **line 24**, **class:** CWE-636 (fail-open on parse error). An invalid preview URL falls back to `baseOrigin` (the admin origin) instead of failing closed. Callers then treat the whole admin origin as the trusted preview peer.
```
return baseOrigin;
```

4. **File:** preview-origin.ts, **line 60**, **class:** CWE-346 / CWE-201 (target origin not constrained). Truthiness is the only check. A caller-supplied or fallback `expectedOrigin` of `"*"` broadcasts the message, and `"null"` is also allowed, despite the comment that `"*"` is never used.
```
peerWindow.postMessage(message, expectedOrigin);
```
